name: nbg-design
description: Use when creating National Bank of Greece (NBG) styled presentations, HTML slides (with a built-in right-click menu: in-place text editing with a formatting toolbar, shape resize/move with a shape toolbar, multi-selection with align / distribute / order / group, a structure outline and HTML panel, pinnable, detachable toolbars that follow the selection, an AI assistant panel that sends the slide's screenshot / source / selection and a clipboard image to Anthropic, Azure Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible, Azure OpenAI or DeepSeek endpoints with saved prompts, "Export to PDF", "Save edited copy"), slide specifications, PDF exports of HTML decks (one page per slide, aesthetics preserved) — all on the bundled NBG Presentation Design System, templates, logos, photography, screenshots, and guardrails.
